listenings.text: The meeting with Mr. Becker was on Tuesday at eleven. I was nervous at first, but Emma was there, and that was a big help. Mr. Becker was in Colombia, so the meeting was on video. His questions were simple. First he asked: How was the harvest this year? I said: The harvest was good, but the weather was very dry. The dry season was long, from May to September. Then he asked about our farms. Were all the farms ready for the EUDR? I said: Not all of them. Twelve farms were ready, and three were not. The meeting was only thirty minutes, but it was a good start.

Hi Carlos, it's Emma. Thank you for Tuesday. You were great in the meeting. Mr. Becker sent me an email this morning. He was very happy with your answers, and he said the numbers were very clear. He has one more question. Was the shipment from Boa Vista delayed because of the weather? Please check and tell me. Oh, and some good news. He is going to visit Brazil in June, in the next harvest, and he wants to meet you. Talk soon.

extra_audio.text: First, the meeting with Mr. Becker was on Tuesday at eleven. Then, Mr. Becker asked: how was the harvest this year? Next, I said: the harvest was good, but the weather was very dry. After that, he asked: were all the farms ready? Twelve farms were ready, and three were not. Finally, on Wednesday Emma called me and said: you were great in the meeting.
